schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.lede: Choose a start and an end to set how long the campaign is active. Setting an end is highly recommended. The end day is exclusive: the campaign stops when it begins.
schedule.startEmpty: Empty: it starts as soon as it is activated.
schedule.endEmpty: Empty: it runs with no end.
schedule.endExclusive: The campaign stops at the start of this day.
schedule.hoursHint: Each day of the window, between these hours. They may cross midnight. Empty: all day.
schedule.localTime: Days and hours are the store’s local time, never UTC.

problem.untilNotAfterFrom: The end must be after the start.
problem.hoursIncomplete: Set both daily hours, or neither.
problem.hoursSame: The daily hours end at another time than they start.

schedule.overnight: These hours run past midnight into the next day.

audience.title: Audience
audience.lede: Where and for whom the campaign runs, before any rule is looked at.
audience.countriesHint: None picked: every country. HQ has no country list yet, so these are the countries the estate sells in.
audience.channelsHint: None picked: every channel. HQ has no channel list yet, so these are the channels known today.
audience.storesAll: Every rule-engine store in the countries above

features.lede: A feature switches on its menu, conditions and effects. You can switch one on after the campaign is created.
features.couponsHint: Codes under a template this campaign owns, and the coupon condition.
features.pointsHint: Arbahi earn and burn conditions and effects.
features.inUse: {{feature}} cannot be switched off: these rules use it.
features.note: A feature a rule uses stays on until that rule stops using it.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.lede: The most discount money, uses or points the campaign may give. A budget is held when the customer pays and committed when the sale closes. A sale that would cross a limit gets nothing from this campaign. A campaign’s coupons have no redemption limits of their own: a coupon or member budget does that job.
budgets.draftNote: Each change is saved as soon as you save it in the drawer.
budgets.liveNote: This campaign is live. Each budget shows what is used against its limit. A new limit applies at once, without republishing, and no counter is reset.
budgets.usageFailedTitle: What is used could not be read
budgets.usageFailed: Try again in a moment. The budgets themselves are shown.
budgets.overshootWhy: A counter can go past its limit when a hold expired, the limit was lowered, or a sale reused an earlier result. HQ adds up what went past, key by key.

profile.title: Member budgets
profile.hint: Counted per member, such as “once per customer”.

coupon.title: Coupon budgets
coupon.hint: Counted per coupon code, such as “each code once”.

drawer.liveNote: The campaign is live, so only the limit changes here. It applies at once, without republishing. To count something else, add a new budget.
drawer.previewWaiting: The sentence shows once the limit is a figure above zero.

problem.notAboveZero: The limit must be above zero.
problem.tooManyDecimals: The limit has more decimals than the currency.

delete.body: The campaign stops counting against it. A rule that reads it will show it as missing.
delete.bodyLive: The campaign stops counting against it. A rule that reads it will show it as missing. What was used against it is kept in HQ’s history.

valueMap.unitHint: The unit the numbers are for, such as EA.

offline.title: Offline
offline.lede: Whether a till that has lost HQ can still run the campaign. HQ works it out from the saved rules, budgets and audience.
offline.safeSentence: Nothing here needs HQ, so an offline till can run it.
offline.optedOutSentence: An offline till could run it, but you keep it to online tills.
offline.unsafeSentence: It needs HQ, so only an online till runs it. It:
offline.optOutHint: Keep it off offline tills anyway.
offline.note: An offline till runs only offline-safe campaigns. Saving the rules works the verdict out again.
offline.noVerdict: HQ gives its offline verdict once the saved draft has no errors. Fix the errors the rule builder lists, then save.

versions.title: Versions
versions.intro: Every activation publishes a version, and so does a disable (the live version without the campaign). A sale keeps the version it started with. Restore makes an earlier version the draft: tills keep the live version until that draft is approved and activated. The evaluation order is not restored.
versions.failedTitle: The versions could not be read
versions.empty: No versions yet. Activating the campaign publishes its first.

held.waiting: A request waits for approval, so its draft cannot be replaced. Restore comes back once the request is sent back or activated.

versions.restored: Version {{version}} is the draft now. The live version is unchanged.
versions.refusedTitle: The version could not be restored
versions.rulesFailedTitle: The version’s rules could not be read
versions.partial: If the member is short of points: {{then}}.

ask.title: Replace the draft?
ask.body: Restoring version <version>{{version}}</version> replaces the campaign’s draft, with any change in it that is not published. That change cannot be got back.
ask.live: Tills keep running version <version>{{version}}</version> until the new draft is approved and activated.

versions.notHeld: This version holds nothing of the campaign to read.

coupons.intro: Codes live in SIS.Coupons under a template this campaign owns, in batches. One campaign coupon per sale. A code has no redemption limit of its own: the campaign’s coupon and profile budgets set how often it works.
coupons.off: Coupons are off for this campaign. Switch them on in <features>Settings ▸ Features</features>.
coupons.failedTitle: The coupon batches could not be read

random.intro: A batch of random codes to share with customers: a mailing, a print run or a partner. The template sets how they look.

universal.intro: One code anyone can use, like a code printed on a flyer. A coupon budget, not the code, limits how often it works.

personal.label: Personal codes
personal.intro: One random code per member, bound to that member. Paste the loyalty ids.
